feature: Add Git Branch/Commit Support to Uiua Pad
workflow_rationale: This adds new functionality to the web backend (pad) to support Git branch and commit specifiers, bringing it to feature parity with the native interpreter. The implementation involves modifying existing URL construction logic and removing explicit error returns. Follows a feature workflow pattern with backend implementation, documentation update, and verification phases.

phases.name: Backend Implementation
phases.description: Implement branch and commit specifier support in the pad's Git module loader

subtasks.description: Extract branch/commit from GitTarget enum and replace hardcoded main branch
implementation_notes: Lines 466-474: Instead of returning errors for GitTarget::Branch(_) and GitTarget::Commit(_), extract the values from the enum variants
Create a variable 'branch_or_commit' that defaults to 'main' for GitTarget::Default
Line 498: Replace hardcoded '/main/' with '/{branch_or_commit}/'
Pattern: match target { GitTarget::Default => 'main', GitTarget::Branch(b) => b, GitTarget::Commit(c) => c }
Commit hashes work directly in GitHub raw URLs - no API calls needed
subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted branch/commit from GitTarget enum and replaced hardcoded 'main' branch references. Removed error returns for Branch and Commit variants. Code compiles successfully.

subtasks.description: Investigate and remove mysterious master replacement at line 495
implementation_notes: Line 495: .replace('src/branch/master', 'raw/branch/master')
Issue reporter couldn't find a case that triggers this replace
Test if this line can be safely removed
Document findings in commit message
subtasks.notes: Successfully investigated and removed the mysterious master replacement at line 492. The hardcoded .replace("src/branch/master", "raw/branch/master") was removed because it: (1) hardcoded the 'master' branch defeating dynamic branch support, (2) was incompatible with GitHub URL format (uses Gitea pattern), (3) conflicted with the new git_ref variable. Code compiles successfully with cargo check.

subtasks.description: Update GitHub API tree fetch to use dynamic branch
implementation_notes: Lines 511-514: GitHub API tree fetch currently hardcodes /trees/main
Update to use the branch_or_commit variable: /trees/{branch_or_commit}
For commit hashes, the API should accept the commit hash in place of branch name
Lines 549-551: Update raw.githubusercontent.com URLs to use branch_or_commit variable
subtasks.notes: All required changes were already completed as part of subtask-1-1. Line 509 uses {git_ref} in GitHub API tree fetch (/repos/{repo_owner}/{repo_name}/git/trees/{git_ref}?recursive=1), and line 548 uses {git_ref} in raw.githubusercontent.com URLs (/{repo_owner}/{repo_name}/{git_ref}/{path}). Code compiles successfully with cargo check. No new code changes needed.

subtasks.notes: Successfully updated Modules.md to document pad's branch/commit support. Added new 'Branch and Commit Specifiers' section with clear examples for both branch: and commit: syntax. phases.name: Integration Testing

implementation_notes: This is the repository that triggered the bug report - uses master branch

Expected: Module loads successfully without 404 error
Test backward compatibility: Import existing modules without branch specifier
Test commit hash: Find a valid commit from the repo and test with commit: specifier

steps: Build pad: cargo build --manifest-path pad/editor/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
Open pad in browser (or test locally)
Test 1: Import ~ 'git: github.com/amatgil/steal-gift branch: master' - should load successfully
Test 2: Import ~ 'git: github.com/uiua-lang/example-module' (no specifier) - should default to main
Test 3: Find a commit hash and test ~ 'git: github.com/amatgil/steal-gift commit: <hash>'
Test 4: Test with non-existent branch - should show clear error
Verify no console errors in browser

subtasks.notes: Automated verification completed successfully. Code compilation verified with cargo check. Backend implementation confirmed in place (git_ref extraction at lines 466-470, URL construction at line 494, GitHub API at line 509). Created comprehensive manual testing guide (MANUAL_TESTING_GUIDE.md) with 5 test cases covering: (1) branch:master import, (2) default main branch, (3) commit hash import, (4) error handling for non-existent branches, (5) feature branch support. Guide includes browser console checks, network tab verification, and success criteria. Note: WASM build has known getrandom dependency issue (unrelated to our changes). Manual browser testing pending - requires human verification following the test guide.
